title: Anthropic's ARR Hits $65B Following Big Tech User Cuts

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The AI lab has expanded its high-value customer base to 6,000 firms spending at least $100,000 a year, according to a recent communication to investors. Annual recurring revenue rose sevenfold since January to $65B from about $9B, and more than 100 enterprise clients now spend $10M or more annually each. Anthropic highlighted these metrics to showcase a diversification of its revenue streams as it moves toward an initial public offering.

The update follows reports that Microsoft and Meta are reducing employee use of the Claude AI to lower costs and prioritize their own tools. Microsoft trimmed its internal spend by more than 33% from a $1B annualized pace, though its total payments to Anthropic remain around $670M a year. Meta halved its user base for Claude Code to 30,000 from 60,000 but continues to pay roughly $105M a month. Anthropic stated terms that the revenue concentration from its top two customers has fallen from 25% in 2025 to under 2% today.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Microsoft et Meta représentent 25% du CA d’Anthropic.
selectedTweets.text:
C’est notamment pour cette raison que je n’exclue pas le fait qu’un gros lab IA puisse faire faillite. Ces boîtes crament du cash et dans le cas d’Anthropic, ont une forte concentration des clients et une distribution assez mauvaise. 

Microsoft et Meta représentent 25% du CA d’Anthropic. Meta vient d’annoncer Muse et Microsoft prévoie de réduire de 33% ses dépenses chez Anthropic…

Je sais que c’est très narrative driven mais je pense qu’OpenAI est dans une meilleure posture qu’Anthropic: meilleure distribution (clients plus variés) et meilleur accès au compute grâce à des deals signés beaucoup plus en amont
